description.value: Ripley Creek Inn is a collection of more than ten restored heritage buildings spread across Stewart, BC — a remote northern community near the Alaskan border, surrounded by glaciers and dramatic mountain terrain. The property spans named structures ranging from the original Main Lodge (completed 2001, 11 rooms each with private bath, fridge, and microwave) to quirky historic houses like The Ritz (dating to 1910) and Peterson House, known as 'The Old Brothel.' An on-site Latin-inspired restaurant, El Tostador, provides full evening dining for guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the inn is a real, operating property in Stewart, BC, with 'WE'RE ALWAYS OPEN!' and 'Open 365 days a year!' stated prominently across multiple pages. Contact details on the website (phone 250 636 2344, email ripleycreekinn@yahoo.com, address 306 5th Ave, Stewart, BC V0T 1W0) all match the OSM tags. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; amenity popup descriptions across all subpages (labelled Wifi, Air conditioner, Phone, TV, Hanger) contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, so individual room amenities cannot be confirmed as evidence.
